info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce User Interface API
info.description:
Access record data, layouts, list views, and navigation items for building custom user interfaces. Powers Lightning web components in Experience Cloud sites with metadata-driven UI rendering. Returns both data and metadata in a single response.

Contact Support:
 Name: Salesforce Developer Support

item.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Get Record UI

query.description: Comma-separated list of child relationship names to include

variable.description: (Required) One or more record IDs (comma-separated for multiple records, up to 200)

request.description: Returns layout information, field data, and object metadata for one or more records. Provides everything needed to render a record detail page including layout sections, field values, and display properties.

response.name: Successfully retrieved record UI data
